During the effect, the user can be hit normally by Ground-type attacks and be affected by Spikes, Toxic Spikes, and Sticky Web, even if the user is a Flying type or has the Levitate Ability.

instruct.name: Instruct
instruct.shortDesc: The target immediately uses its last used move.
instruct.desc: The target immediately uses its last used move. Fails if the target has not made a move, if the move has 0 PP, if the target is preparing to use Beak Blast, Focus Punch, or Shell Trap, or if the move is Assist, Beak Blast, Belch, Bide, Blazing Torque, Celebrate, Chatter, Combat Torque, Copycat, Dynamax Cannon, Focus Punch, Hold Hands, Ice Ball, Instruct, King's Shield, Magical Torque, Me First, Metronome, Mimic, Mirror Move, Nature Power, Noxious Torque, Obstruct, Outrage, Petal Dance, Rollout, Shell Trap, Sketch, Sleep Talk, Struggle, Thrash, Transform, Uproar, Wicked Torque, any two-turn move, or any recharge move.

irondefense.name: Iron Defense

junglehealing.name: Jungle Healing
junglehealing.shortDesc: User and allies: healed 1/4 max HP, status cured.
junglehealing.desc: Each Pokemon on the user's side restores 1/4 of its maximum HP, rounded half up, and has its status condition cured.

kingsshield.name: King's Shield

X resets to 1 if this move fails, if the user's last move used is not Baneful Bunker, Burning Bulwark, Detect, Endure, King's Shield, Max Guard, Obstruct, Protect, Quick Guard, Silk Trap, Spiky Shield, or Wide Guard, or if it was one of those moves and the user's protection was broken. Lasts for 8 turns if the user is holding Light Clay. Fails if the effect is already active on the user's side.

liquify.name: Liquify

magnetrise.name: Magnet Rise
magnetrise.shortDesc: For 5 turns, the user has immunity to Ground.
magnetrise.desc: For 5 turns, the user is immune to Ground-type attacks and the effects of Spikes, Toxic Spikes, Sticky Web, and the Arena Trap Ability as long as it remains active. reflecttype.shortDesc: User becomes the same type as the target.
reflecttype.desc: Causes the user's types to become the same as the current types of the target. If the target's current types include typeless and a non-added type, typeless is ignored. If the target's current types include typeless and an added type from Forest's Curse or Trick-or-Treat, typeless is copied as the Normal type instead. Fails if the user is an Arceus or a Silvally, if the user is Terastallized, or if the target's current type is typeless alone.

refresh.name: Refresh
refresh.shortDesc: User cures its burn, poison, or paralysis.
refresh.desc: The user cures its burn, poison, or paralysis. Fails if the user is not burned, poisoned, or paralyzed.

rest.name: Rest
rest.shortDesc: User sleeps 2 turns and restores HP and status.
rest.desc: The user falls asleep for the next two turns and restores all of its HP, curing itself of any non-volatile status condition in the process. Fails if the user has full HP, is already asleep, or if another effect is preventing sleep.

revivalblessing.name: Revival Blessing
revivalblessing.shortDesc: Revives a fainted Pokemon to 50% HP.
revivalblessing.desc: A fainted party member is selected and revived with 1/2 its max HP, rounded down. Fails if there are no fainted party members.

roar.name: Roar
roar.desc: -6 priority. Forces target to switch out, and drags in a random teammate. If there are no teammates to switch to, Roar fails; SOUND: This move bypasses substitutes

rockpolish.name: Rock Polish
rockpolish.shortDesc: Boosts user's Speed 2 stages, Accuracy 1 stage
rockpolish.desc: Boosts user's Speed 2 stages, Accuracy 1 stage

roleplay.name: Role Play
roleplay.shortDesc: User replaces its Ability with the target's.
roleplay.desc: The user's Ability changes to match the target's Ability. Fails if the user's Ability is As One, Battle Bond, Comatose, Disguise, Gulp Missile, Ice Face, Multitype, Power Construct, RKS System, Schooling, Shields Down, Stance Change, Tera Shift, Zen Mode, Zero to Hero, or already matches the target, or if the target's Ability is As One, Battle Bond, Comatose, Commander, Disguise, Embody Aspect, Flower Gift, Forecast, Hunger Switch, Ice Face, Illusion, Imposter, Multitype, Neutralizing Gas, Poison Puppeteer, Power Construct, Power of Alchemy, Protosynthesis, Quark Drive, Receiver, RKS System, Schooling, Shields Down, Stance Change, Tera Shell, Tera Shift, Teraform Zero, Trace, Wonder Guard, Zen Mode, or Zero to Hero.

roost.name: Roost
roost.shortDesc: Heals 50% HP. Flying-type removed 'til turn ends.
roost.desc: The user restores 1/2 of its maximum HP, rounded half up. If the user is not Terastallized, until the end of the turn Flying-type users lose their Flying type and pure Flying-type users become Normal type. Does nothing if the user's HP is full.

roundhousekick.name: Roundhouse Kick
roundhousekick.shortDesc: +5 priority. Focuses and counters damaging attacks.
roundhousekick.desc: +5 priority. User focuses to counter incoming attacks, taking 1/8 damage and immediately returning a 90 BP Roundhouse Kick to each damaging attacker.

safeguard.name: Safeguard
safeguard.shortDesc: For 5 turns, protects user's party from status.
safeguard.desc: For 5 turns, the user and its party members cannot have non-volatile status conditions or confusion inflicted on them by other Pokemon. Pokemon on the user's side cannot become affected by Yawn but can fall asleep from its effect. It is removed from the user's side if the user or an ally is successfully hit by Defog. Fails if the effect is already active on the user's side.

sandstorm.name: Sandstorm
sandstorm.shortDesc: Sets Sandstorm for 4 turns [11 with Smooth Rock]
sandstorm.desc: Sets Sandstorm for 4 turns [11 with Smooth Rock]

screech.name: Screech
screech.desc: Lowers target's Defense [-2 stages]; SOUND: This move bypasses substitutes

shadowclone.name: Shadow Clone
shadowclone.shortDesc: Transforms into target, then makes a Substitute. Reverts when it breaks.
shadowclone.desc: User transforms into the target, then creates a Substitute at the cost of 1/4 max HP. When the clone breaks or ends, the transformation ends as well.

sharpen.name: Sharpen
sharpen.shortDesc: +1 Atk, +1 Acc, +1 Crit. Volatile: Slice/Weapon affinity
sharpen.desc: Boosts user's Attack, Accuracy, and Crit Ratio +1 stage. Until user switches out, gain an affinity for Slice/Weapon moves.

shatteredpsyche.name: Shattered Psyche
shatteredpsyche.shortDesc: Inflictes target with 'Migraine' Aura for 5 turns
shatteredpsyche.desc: Inflictes target with 'Migraine' Aura for 5 turns

shedtail.name: Shed Tail
shedtail.shortDesc: User takes 1/2 its max HP to pass a substitute.
shedtail.desc: The user takes 1/2 of its maximum HP, rounded up, and creates a substitute that has 1/4 of the user's maximum HP, rounded down. The user is replaced with another Pokemon in its party and the selected Pokemon has the substitute transferred to it. Fails if the user would faint, or if there are no unfainted party members.

shellsmash.name: Shell Smash
shellsmash.shortDesc: +2 ATK & Sp.ATK & SPE: User. -2 DEF & Sp.DEF: User
shellsmash.desc: Boosts user's Attack, Special Attack, Speed [+2 stages]. Lowers user's Defense, Special Defense [-2 stages]

shelter.name: Shelter
shelter.shortDesc: +2 DEF: User. Volatile: User is immune to Critical hits, Pierce moves, and protection breaking effects
shelter.desc: Boosts user's Defense [+2 stages]. Volatile: User is immune to Critical hits, Pierce moves, and protection breaking effects

shiftgear.name: Shift Gear
shiftgear.desc: Boosts user's Speed [+2 stages], and Attack [+1 stage]

shoreup.name: Shore Up
shoreup.shortDesc: User restores 1/2 its max HP; 2/3 in Sandstorm.
shoreup.desc: The user restores 1/2 of its maximum HP, rounded half down. If the weather is Sandstorm, the user instead restores 2/3 of its maximum HP, rounded half down.

silktrap.name: Silk Trap
silktrap.shortDesc: +4 priority. Protects user. If hit by a Contact move: Lower the attacker's Speed [-2 stages]
silktrap.desc: +4 priority. Protects user. If hit by a Contact move: Lower the attacker's Speed [-2 stages]

silverpowder.name: Silver Powder
silverpowder.shortDesc: Applies Silver Powder to opposing side for 3 turns
silverpowder.desc: Applies Silver Powder to opposing side for 3 turns. Deal 1/8Hp to Dragon/Fairy/Ghost types. Reduce Misty Terrain duration 2 turns. Clear and prevent Magic Dust. If hit by, or attempts to use a Fire type move, explode, dealing 1/8HP

simplebeam.name: Simple Beam
simplebeam.desc: Causes the target's Ability to become Simple. Fails if the target's Ability is As One, Battle Bond, Comatose, Disguise, Gulp Missile, Ice Face, Multitype, Power Construct, RKS System, Schooling, Shields Down, Simple, Stance Change, Tera Shift, Truant, Zen Mode, or Zero to Hero.

sing.name: Sing
sing.desc: Puts target to Sleep; SOUND: This move bypasses substitutes

sketch.name: Sketch
sketch.shortDesc: Permanently copies the last move target used.
sketch.desc: This move is permanently replaced by the last move used by the target. The copied move has the maximum PP for that move. Fails if the target has not made a move, if the user has Transformed, or if the move is Blazing Torque, Combat Torque, Dark Void, Hyperspace Fury, Magical Torque, Noxious Torque, Revival Blessing, Sketch, Struggle, Tera Starstorm, Wicked Torque, or any move the user knows.

skillswap.name: Skill Swap
skillswap.shortDesc: The user and the target trade Abilities.
skillswap.desc: The user swaps its Ability with the target's Ability. Fails if either the user or the target's Ability is As One, Battle Bond, Comatose, Commander, Disguise, Embody Aspect, Hunger Switch, Ice Face, Illusion, Multitype, Neutralizing Gas, Poison Puppeteer, Power Construct, Protosynthesis, Quark Drive, RKS System, Schooling, Shields Down, Stance Change, Tera Shell, Tera Shift, Teraform Zero, Wonder Guard, Zen Mode, or Zero to Hero.

slackoff.name: Slack Off
slackoff.shortDesc: Heals the user by 50% of its max HP.
slackoff.desc: The user restores 1/2 of its maximum HP, rounded half up.

sleeppowder.name: Sleep Powder
sleeppowder.shortDesc: Causes the target to fall asleep.
sleeppowder.desc: Causes the target to fall asleep.

sleeptalk.name: Sleep Talk
sleeptalk.shortDesc: User must be asleep. Uses another known move.
sleeptalk.desc: One of the user's known moves, besides this move, is selected for use at random. Fails if the user is not asleep. The selected move does not have PP deducted from it, and can currently have 0 PP. This move cannot select Assist, Beak Blast, Belch, Bide, Blazing Torque, Celebrate, Chatter, Combat Torque, Copycat, Dynamax Cannon, Focus Punch, Hold Hands, Magical Torque, Me First, Metronome, Mimic, Mirror Move, Nature Power, Noxious Torque, Shell Trap, Sketch, Sleep Talk, Struggle, Uproar, Wicked Torque, or any two-turn move.

smokescreen.name: Smokescreen
smokescreen.desc: Lowers the target's accuracy by 1 stage.

snatch.name: Snatch
snatch.shortDesc: +4 priority. After use, if another pokemon tries to use a Status move, steal it
snatch.desc: +4 priority. After use, if another pokemon [including an ally] tries to use a beneficial Status move, use the move first, and prevent them from acting

snowscape.name: Snowscape
snowscape.shortDesc: Sets Snow for 7 turns [11 with Icy Rock]
snowscape.desc: Sets Snow for 7 turns [11 with Icy Rock]

soak.name: Soak
soak.shortDesc: Changes the target's type to Water.
soak.desc: Causes the target to become a Water type. Fails if the target is an Arceus or a Silvally, if the target is already purely Water type, or if the target is Terastallized.

softboiled.name: Soft-Boiled
softboiled.shortDesc: Heals the user by 50% of its max HP.
softboiled.desc: The user restores 1/2 of its maximum HP, rounded half up.

sparkofbrilliance.name: Spark of Brilliance
sparkofbrilliance.shortDesc: Sets Electric Terrain, then switches out.
sparkofbrilliance.desc: Sets Electric Terrain and switches the user out.

speedswap.name: Speed Swap
speedswap.desc: The user swaps its Speed stat with the target. Stat stage changes are unaffected.

spikes.name: Spikes
spikes.shortDesc: Hurts grounded foes on switch-in. Max 3 layers.
spikes.desc: Sets up a hazard on the opposing side of the field, damaging each opposing Pokemon that switches in, unless it is a Flying-type Pokemon or has the Levitate Ability. Can be used up to three times before failing. Opponents lose 1/8 of their maximum HP with one layer, 1/6 of their maximum HP with two layers, and 1/4 of their maximum HP with three layers, all rounded down. Can be removed from the opposing side if any Pokemon uses Tidy Up, or if any opposing Pokemon uses Mortal Spin, Rapid Spin, or Defog successfully, or is hit by Defog.

spikyshield.name: Spiky Shield
spikyshield.shortDesc: +4 priority. Protects user. If hit by a Contact move: Deal 1/8HP to the attacker
spikyshield.desc: +4 priority. Protects user. If hit by a Contact move: Deal 1/8HP to the attacker

spite.name: Spite
spite.shortDesc: Lowers the PP of the target's last move by 4.
spite.desc: Causes the target's last move used to lose 4 PP. Fails if the target has not made a move, if the move has 0 PP, or if it no longer knows the move.

spore.name: Spore
spore.shortDesc: Causes the target to fall asleep.
spore.desc: Causes the target to fall asleep.

stealthrock.name: Stealth Rock
stealthrock.shortDesc: Hurts foes on switch-in. Factors Rock weakness.
stealthrock.desc: Sets up a hazard on the opposing side of the field, damaging each opposing Pokemon that switches in. Fails if the effect is already active on the opposing side. Foes lose 1/32, 1/16, 1/8, 1/4, or 1/2 of their maximum HP, rounded down, based on their weakness to the Rock type; 0.25x, 0.5x, neutral, 2x, or 4x, respectively. Can be removed from the opposing side if any Pokemon uses Tidy Up, or if any opposing Pokemon uses Mortal Spin, Rapid Spin, or Defog successfully, or is hit by Defog.

stickyweb.name: Sticky Web
stickyweb.shortDesc: Lowers Speed of grounded foes by 1 on switch-in.
stickyweb.desc: Sets up a hazard on the opposing side of the field, lowering the Speed by 1 stage of each opposing Pokemon that switches in, unless it is a Flying-type Pokemon or has the Levitate Ability. Fails if the effect is already active on the opposing side. Can be removed from the opposing side if any Pokemon uses Tidy Up, or if any opposing Pokemon uses Mortal Spin, Rapid Spin, or Defog successfully, or is hit by Defog.

stockpile.name: Stockpile
stockpile.shortDesc: Raises user's Defense, Sp. Def by 1. Max 3 uses.
stockpile.desc: Raises the user's Defense and Special Defense by 1 stage. The user's Stockpile count increases by 1. Fails if the user's Stockpile count is 3. The user's Stockpile count is reset to 0 when it is no longer active.

strengthsap.name: Strength Sap
strengthsap.shortDesc: User heals HP=target's Atk stat. Lowers Atk by 1.
strengthsap.desc: Lowers the target's Attack by 1 stage. The user restores its HP equal to the target's Attack stat calculated with its stat stage before this move was used. If Big Root is held by the user, the HP recovered is 1.3x normal, rounded half down. Fails if the target's Attack stat stage is -6.

stringshot.name: String Shot
stringshot.desc: Lowers the target's Speed by 2 stages.

stuffcheeks.name: Stuff Cheeks
stuffcheeks.shortDesc: Must hold Berry to use. User eats Berry, Def +2.
stuffcheeks.desc: This move cannot be selected unless the user is holding a Berry. The user eats its Berry and raises its Defense by 2 stages. This effect is not prevented by the Klutz or Unnerve Abilities, or the effects of Embargo or Magic Room. Fails if the user is not holding a Berry.

substitute.name: Substitute
substitute.shortDesc: User takes 1/4 its max HP to put in a substitute.
substitute.desc: The user takes 1/4 of its maximum HP, rounded down, and puts it into a substitute to take its place in battle. The substitute is removed once enough damage is inflicted on it, if the user switches out or faints, or if any Pokemon uses Tidy Up. Baton Pass can be used to transfer the substitute to an ally, and the substitute will keep its remaining HP. Until the substitute is broken, it receives damage from all attacks made by other Pokemon and shields the user from status effects and stat stage changes caused by other Pokemon. Sound-based moves and Pokemon with the Infiltrator Ability ignore substitutes. The user still takes normal damage from weather and status effects while behind its substitute. If the substitute breaks during a multi-hit attack, the user will take damage from any remaining hits. If a substitute is created while the user is trapped by a binding move, the binding effect ends immediately. Fails if the user does not have enough HP remaining to create a substitute without fainting, or if it already has a substitute.

sunnyday.name: Sunny Day
sunnyday.shortDesc: Sets Sun for 5 turns [8 with Heat Rock]
sunnyday.desc: Sets Sun for 5 turns [8 with Heat Rock]

supersonic.name: Supersonic
supersonic.desc: Confuses target; SOUND: This move bypasses substitutes

swagger.name: Swagger
swagger.shortDesc: Raises the target's Attack by 2 and confuses it.
swagger.desc: Raises the target's Attack by 2 stages and confuses it.

swallow.name: Swallow
swallow.shortDesc: Heals based on # of Stockpile Stocks. After use, lose 1 Stock. Fails if user has 0 Stocks
swallow.desc: Heals based on # of Stockpile Stocks. After use, lose 1 Stock. Fails if user has 0 Stocks

sweetscent.name: Sweet Scent
sweetscent.desc: Lowers the target's evasiveness by 2 stages.

switcheroo.name: Switcheroo
switcheroo.shortDesc: User switches its held item with the target's.
switcheroo.desc: The user swaps its held item with the target's held item. Fails if either the user or the target is holding a Mail or Z-Crystal, if neither is holding an item, if the user is trying to give or take a Mega Stone to or from the species that can Mega Evolve with it, or if the user is trying to give or take a Blue Orb, a Red Orb, a Griseous Orb, a Plate, a Drive, or a Memory to or from a Kyogre, a Groudon, a Giratina, an Arceus, a Genesect, or a Silvally, respectively. The target is immune to this move if it has the Sticky Hold Ability.

synthesis.name: Synthesis
synthesis.shortDesc: Heals the user by a weather-dependent amount.
synthesis.desc: The user restores 1/2 of its maximum HP if Delta Stream or no weather conditions are in effect or if the user is holding Utility Umbrella, 2/3 of its maximum HP if the weather is Desolate Land or Sunny Day, and 1/4 of its maximum HP if the weather is Primordial Sea, Rain Dance, Sandstorm, or Snow, all rounded half down.

tailwhip.name: Tail Whip
tailwhip.desc: Lowers the target's Defense by 1 stage.

tailwind.name: Tailwind
tailwind.shortDesc: For 4 turns, allies' Speed is doubled.
tailwind.desc: For 4 turns, the user and its party members have their Speed doubled. Fails if this move is already in effect for the user's side.

takeheart.name: Take Heart
takeheart.shortDesc: Cures user's status, raises Sp. Atk, Sp. Def by 1.
takeheart.desc: The user cures its non-volatile status condition. Raises the user's Special Attack and Special Defense by 1 stage.

tarshot.name: Tar Shot
tarshot.shortDesc: Volatile: For 3 turns. Trap target, they are dealt 1/10HP per turn, Become 1 tier weaker to Fire type, and move last in their priority bracket. When hit by a Fire type move, they explode, dealing 1/10HP
tarshot.desc: Volatile: For 3 turns. Trap target, they are dealt 1/10HP per turn, Become 1 tier weaker to Fire type, and move last in their priority bracket. When hit by a Fire type move, they explode, dealing 1/10HP

taunt.name: Taunt
taunt.shortDesc: Target can't use status moves its next 3 turns.
taunt.desc: Prevents the target from using non-damaging moves for its next three turns. Pokemon with the Oblivious Ability or protected by the Aroma Veil Ability are immune.

tearfullook.name: Tearful Look
tearfullook.desc: Lowers target's Attack and Special Attack [-1 stage]

telekinesis.name: Telekinesis
telekinesis.shortDesc: Boosts weird particle of Psychic Terrain, allowing it to affect fliers. Volatile: For 4 turns, force user's side, or foe's side into the air
telekinesis.desc: Boosts weird particle of Psychic Terrain, allowing it to affect fliers. Volatile: For 4 turns, force user's side, or foe's side into the air

throwshade.name: Throw Shade
throwshade.shortDesc: Sets Sandstorm for 5 turns (9 with Smooth Rock), then switches out.
throwshade.desc: Sets Sandstorm for 5 turns, or 9 turns if the user holds a Smooth Rock, then switches the user out.

thunderwave.name: Thunder Wave
thunderwave.desc: Paralyzes the target. This move does not ignore type immunity.

tickle.name: Tickle
tickle.shortDesc: Lowers the target's Attack and Defense by 1.
tickle.desc: Lowers the target's Attack and Defense by 1 stage.

tidyup.name: Tidy Up
tidyup.shortDesc: User +1 Atk, Spe. Clears all substitutes/hazards.
tidyup.desc: Raises the user's Attack and Speed by 1 stage. Removes substitutes from all active Pokemon and ends the effects of Spikes, Stealth Rock, Sticky Web, and Toxic Spikes for both sides.

topsyturvy.name: Topsy-Turvy
topsyturvy.desc: The target's positive stat stages become negative and vice versa. Fails if all of the target's stat stages are 0.

torment.name: Torment
torment.shortDesc: Target can't select the same move twice in a row.
torment.desc: Prevents the target from selecting the same move for use two turns in a row. This effect ends when the target is no longer active.

toxic.name: Toxic
toxic.shortDesc: Badly poisons the target. Poison types can't miss.
toxic.desc: Badly poisons the target. If a Poison-type Pokemon uses this move, the target cannot avoid the attack, even if the target is in the middle of a two-turn move.

toxicdiscourse.name: Toxic Discourse
toxicdiscourse.shortDesc: Sets Toxic Terrain, then switches out.
toxicdiscourse.desc: Sets Toxic Terrain and switches the user out.

toxicspikes.name: Toxic Spikes
toxicspikes.shortDesc: Poisons grounded foes on switch-in. Max 2 layers.
toxicspikes.desc: Sets up a hazard on the opposing side of the field, poisoning each opposing Pokemon that switches in, unless it is a Flying-type Pokemon or has the Levitate Ability. Can be used up to two times before failing. Opposing Pokemon become poisoned with one layer and badly poisoned with two layers. Can be removed from the opposing side if any Pokemon uses Tidy Up, or if any opposing Pokemon uses Mortal Spin, Rapid Spin, or Defog successfully, is hit by Defog, or a grounded Poison-type Pokemon switches in. Safeguard prevents the opposing party from being poisoned on switch-in, but a substitute does not.

toxicterrain.name: Toxic Terrain
toxicterrain.shortDesc: Sets Toxic Terrain for 4 turns [11 with Terrain Extender]
toxicterrain.desc: Sets Toxic Terrain for 4 turns [11 with Terrain Extender]

toxicthread.name: Toxic Thread
toxicthread.shortDesc: Grounded Entry hazard that lowers Speed [-1 stage] and Poisons the target [Toxic Poison under Toxic Terrain]. Cannot be absorbed by Poison types
toxicthread.desc: Grounded Entry hazard that lowers Speed [-1 stage] and Poisons the target [Toxic Poison under Toxic Terrain]. Cannot be absorbed by Poison types

transform.name: Transform
transform.shortDesc: Copies target's stats, moves, types, and Ability.
transform.desc: The user transforms into the target. The target's current stats, stat stages, types, moves, Ability, weight, gender, and sprite are copied. The user's level and HP remain the same and each copied move receives only 5 PP, with a maximum of 5 PP each. The user can no longer change formes if it would have the ability to do so. This move fails if it hits a substitute, if either the user or the target is already transformed, or if either is behind an Illusion.

trick.name: Trick
trick.shortDesc: User switches its held item with the target's.
trick.desc: The user swaps its held item with the target's held item. Fails if either the user or the target is holding a Mail or Z-Crystal, if neither is holding an item, if the user is trying to give or take a Mega Stone to or from the species that can Mega Evolve with it, or if the user is trying to give or take a Blue Orb, a Red Orb, a Griseous Orb, a Plate, a Drive, or a Memory to or from a Kyogre, a Groudon, a Giratina, an Arceus, a Genesect, or a Silvally, respectively. The target is immune to this move if it has the Sticky Hold Ability.

trickroom.name: Trick Room
trickroom.shortDesc: -7 priority. Sets Trick Room for 5 turns
trickroom.desc: -7 priority. Sets Trick Room for 5 turns, reversing the speed order. Slower pokemon move first [priority is unaffected]

turbulentwinds.name: Turbulent Winds
turbulentwinds.shortDesc: Sets Turbulent Winds for 7 turns [11 with Aeolic Rock]
turbulentwinds.desc: Sets Turbulent Winds for 7 turns [11 with Aeolic Rock]

victorydance.name: Victory Dance
victorydance.desc: Boosts user's Attack, Defense, and Speed [+2 stages]

whirlwind.name: Whirlwind
whirlwind.desc: -6 priority. Forces target to switch out, and drags in a random teammate. If there are no teammates to switch to, Roar fails

wideguard.name: Wide Guard
wideguard.shortDesc: +3 priority. Protects user and ally from spread moves
wideguard.desc: +3 priority. Protects user and ally from spread moves

wish.name: Wish
wish.shortDesc: Next turn, 50% of the user's max HP is restored.
wish.desc: At the end of the next turn, the Pokemon at the user's position has 1/2 of the user's maximum HP restored to it, rounded down. Fails if this move is already in effect for the user's position.

withdraw.name: Withdraw
withdraw.shortDesc: +1 DEF: User. Halves damage taken till end of turn
withdraw.desc: Boosts user's Defense [+1 stages]. Halves damage taken till end of turn

wonderroom.name: Wonder Room
wonderroom.shortDesc: For 5 turns, all Defense and Sp. Def stats switch.
wonderroom.desc: For 5 turns, all active Pokemon have their Defense and Special Defense stats swapped. Stat stage changes are unaffected. If this move is used during the effect, the effect ends.

workup.name: Work Up
workup.desc: Boosts user's Attack and Special Attack [+1 stages]

worryseed.name: Worry Seed
worryseed.desc: Causes the target's Ability to become Insomnia. Fails if the target's Ability is As One, Battle Bond, Comatose, Disguise, Gulp Missile, Ice Face, Insomnia, Multitype, Power Construct, RKS System, Schooling, Shields Down, Stance Change, Tera Shift, Truant, Zen Mode, or Zero to Hero.

seismiccore.desc: This move is tied to an ability effect. If you're seeing this, something is wrong

minimize.name: Minimize
minimize.desc: Raises the user's evasiveness by 2 stages. Whether or not the user's evasiveness was changed, Body Slam, Dragon Rush, Flying Press, Heat Crash, Heavy Slam, Malicious Moonsault, Steamroller, Stomp, and Supercell Slam will not check accuracy and have their damage doubled if used against the user while it is active.

forestscurse.name: Forest's Curse
forestscurse.shortDesc: Adds Grass to the target's type(s).
forestscurse.desc: Causes the Grass type to be added to the target, effectively making it have two or three types. Fails if the target is already a Grass type. If Trick-or-Treat adds a type to the target, it replaces the type added by this move and vice versa.

fissure.name: Fissure
fissure.shortDesc: OHKOs the target. Fails if user is a lower level.
fissure.desc: Deals damage to the target equal to the target's maximum HP. Ignores accuracy and evasiveness modifiers. This attack's accuracy is equal to (user's level - target's level + 30)%, and fails if the target is at a higher level. Pokemon with the Sturdy Ability are immune.

sheercold.name: Sheer Cold
sheercold.shortDesc: OHKOs non-Ice targets. Fails if user's lower level.
sheercold.desc: Deals damage to the target equal to the target's maximum HP. Ignores accuracy and evasiveness modifiers. This attack's accuracy is equal to (user's level - target's level + X)%, where X is 30 if the user is an Ice type and 20 otherwise, and fails if the target is at a higher level. Ice-type Pokemon and Pokemon with the Sturdy Ability are immune.

guillotine.name: Guillotine
guillotine.shortDesc: OHKOs the target. Fails if user is a lower level.
guillotine.desc: Deals damage to the target equal to the target's maximum HP. Ignores accuracy and evasiveness modifiers. This attack's accuracy is equal to (user's level - target's level + 30)%, and fails if the target is at a higher level. Pokemon with the Sturdy Ability are immune.

anchorshot.name: Anchor Shot
anchorshot.shortDesc: Prevents the target from switching out.
anchorshot.desc: Prevents the target from switching out. The target can still switch out if it is holding Shed Shell or uses Baton Pass, Flip Turn, Parting Shot, Teleport, U-turn, or Volt Switch. The effect ends if either the user or the target leaves the field.

chipaway.name: Chip Away
chipaway.shortDesc: Ignores the target's stat stage changes.
chipaway.desc: Ignores the target's stat stage changes, including evasiveness.

cometpunch.name: Comet Punch
cometpunch.desc: Hits two to five times. Has a 35% chance to hit two or three times and a 15% chance to hit four or five times. If one of the hits breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the remaining hits. If the user has the Skill Link Ability, this move will always hit five times.

constrict.name: Constrict
constrict.shortDesc: 10% chance to lower the target's Speed by 1.
constrict.desc: Has a 10% chance to lower the target's Speed by 1 stage.

dizzypunch.name: Dizzy Punch
dizzypunch.desc: Has a 20% chance to confuse the target.

doubleironbash.name: Double Iron Bash
doubleironbash.shortDesc: Hits twice. 30% chance to make the target flinch.
doubleironbash.desc: Hits twice. If the first hit breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the second hit. Has a 30% chance to make the target flinch.

doubleslap.name: Double Slap
doubleslap.desc: Hits two to five times. Has a 35% chance to hit two or three times and a 15% chance to hit four or five times. If one of the hits breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the remaining hits. If the user has the Skill Link Ability, this move will always hit five times.

dualchop.name: Dual Chop
dualchop.desc: Hits twice. If the first hit breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the second hit.

feintattack.name: Feint Attack
feintattack.shortDesc: This move does not check accuracy.
feintattack.desc: This move does not check accuracy.

fishiousrend.name: Fishious Rend
fishiousrend.shortDesc: Power doubles if user moves before the target.
fishiousrend.desc: Power doubles if the user moves before the target.

frustration.name: Frustration
frustration.desc: Power is equal to the greater of ((255 - user's Happiness) * 2/5), rounded down, or 1.

heartstamp.name: Heart Stamp
heartstamp.shortDesc: 30% chance to make the target flinch.
heartstamp.desc: Has a 30% chance to make the target flinch.

hyperfang.name: Hyper Fang
hyperfang.shortDesc: 10% chance to make the target flinch.
hyperfang.desc: Has a 10% chance to make the target flinch.

iceball.name: Ice Ball
iceball.shortDesc: Power doubles with each hit. Repeats for 5 turns.
iceball.desc: If this move is successful, the user is locked into this move and cannot make another move until it misses, 5 turns have passed, or the attack cannot be used. Power doubles with each successful hit of this move and doubles again if Defense Curl was used previously by the user. If this move is called by Sleep Talk, the move is used for one turn.

karatechop.name: Karate Chop
karatechop.desc: If this move misses, user takes recoil damage [In Indigo Starstorm, this inculdes damage that would have been dealt had the target not reached 0HP first]

landswrath.name: Land's Wrath
landswrath.shortDesc: No additional effect. Hits adjacent foes.

meteorassault.name: Meteor Assault
meteorassault.shortDesc: User must recharge the turn after this move is used.
meteorassault.desc: User must recharge the turn after this move is used.

multiattack.name: Multi-Attack
multiattack.shortDesc: Type varies based on the held Memory.
multiattack.desc: This move's type depends on the user's held Memory.

naturalgift.name: Natural Gift
naturalgift.shortDesc: Power and type depends on the user's Berry.
naturalgift.desc: The type and power of this move depend on the user's held Berry, and the Berry is lost. Fails if the user is not holding a Berry, if the user has the Klutz Ability, or if Embargo or Magic Room is in effect for the user.

plasmafists.name: Plasma Fists
plasmafists.shortDesc: Normal moves become Electric type this turn.
plasmafists.desc: If this move is successful, causes Normal-type moves to become Electric type this turn.

punishment.name: Punishment
punishment.shortDesc: 60 power +20 for each of the target's stat boosts.
punishment.desc: Power is equal to 60+(X*20), where X is the target's total stat stage changes that are greater than 0, but not more than 200 power.

rage.name: Rage
rage.shortDesc: Raises the user's Attack by 1 if hit during use.
rage.desc: Once this move is successfully used, the user's Attack is raised by 1 stage every time it is hit by another Pokemon's attack as long as this move is chosen for use.

return.name: Return
return.desc: Power is equal to the greater of (user's Happiness * 2/5), rounded down, or 1.

rollingkick.name: Rolling Kick
rollingkick.shortDesc: 30% chance to make the target flinch.
rollingkick.desc: Has a 30% chance to make the target flinch.

secretpower.name: Secret Power
secretpower.shortDesc: Effect varies with terrain. (30% paralysis chance)
secretpower.desc: Has a 30% chance to cause a secondary effect on the target based on the battle terrain. Causes paralysis on the regular Wi-Fi terrain, causes paralysis during Electric Terrain, lowers Special Attack by 1 stage during Misty Terrain, causes sleep during Grassy Terrain and lowers Speed by 1 stage during Psychic Terrain.

skullbash.name: Skull Bash
skullbash.desc: Charges up on first turn, attacks on the second turn

smellingsalts.name: Smelling Salts
smellingsalts.shortDesc: Power doubles if target is paralyzed, and cures it.
smellingsalts.desc: Power doubles if the target is paralyzed. If the user has not fainted, the target is cured of paralysis.

spectralthief.name: Spectral Thief
spectralthief.shortDesc: Steals target's boosts before dealing damage.
spectralthief.desc: The target's stat stages greater than 0 are stolen from it and applied to the user before dealing damage.

stormthrow.name: Storm Throw
stormthrow.shortDesc: Always results in a critical hit.
stormthrow.desc: This move is always a critical hit unless the target is under the effect of Lucky Chant or has the Battle Armor or Shell Armor Abilities.

submission.name: Submission
submission.desc: If the target lost HP, the user takes recoil damage equal to 1/4 the HP lost by the target, rounded half up, but not less than 1 HP.

thousandarrows.name: Thousand Arrows
thousandarrows.shortDesc: Grounds adjacent foes. First hit neutral on Flying.
thousandarrows.desc: This move can hit airborne Pokemon, which includes Flying-type Pokemon, Pokemon with the Levitate Ability, Pokemon holding an Air Balloon, and Pokemon under the effect of Magnet Rise or Telekinesis. If the target is a Flying type and is not already grounded, this move deals neutral damage regardless of its other type(s). This move can hit a target using Bounce, Fly, or Sky Drop. If this move hits a target under the effect of Bounce, Fly, Magnet Rise, or Telekinesis, the effect ends. If the target is a Flying type that has not used Roost this turn or a Pokemon with the Levitate Ability, it loses its immunity to Ground-type attacks and the Arena Trap Ability as long as it remains active. During the effect, Magnet Rise fails for the target and Telekinesis fails against the target.

thousandwaves.name: Thousand Waves
thousandwaves.shortDesc: Hits adjacent foes. Prevents them from switching.
thousandwaves.desc: Prevents the target from switching out. The target can still switch out if it is holding Shed Shell or uses Baton Pass, Flip Turn, Parting Shot, Teleport, U-turn, or Volt Switch. The effect ends if either the user or the target leaves the field.

wakeupslap.name: Wake-Up Slap
wakeupslap.shortDesc: Power doubles if target is asleep, and wakes it.
wakeupslap.desc: Power doubles if the target is asleep. If the user has not fainted, the target wakes up.

coreenforcer.name: Core Enforcer
coreenforcer.shortDesc: Nullifies the foe(s) Ability if the foe(s) move first.
coreenforcer.desc: If the user moves after the target, the target's Ability is rendered ineffective as long as it remains active. If the target uses Baton Pass, the replacement will remain under this effect. If the target's Ability is As One, Battle Bond, Comatose, Disguise, Gulp Missile, Ice Face, Multitype, Power Construct, RKS System, Schooling, Shields Down, Stance Change, Tera Shift, Zen Mode, or Zero to Hero, this effect does not happen, and receiving the effect through Baton Pass ends the effect immediately.

eternabeam.name: Eternabeam
eternabeam.shortDesc: User must recharge the turn after this move is used.
eternabeam.desc: User must recharge the turn after this move is used.

lightofruin.name: Light of Ruin
lightofruin.desc: If the target lost HP, the user takes recoil damage equal to 1/2 the HP lost by the target, rounded half up, but not less than 1 HP.

mindblown.name: Mind Blown
mindblown.shortDesc: User loses 50% max HP. Hits adjacent Pokemon.
mindblown.desc: Whether or not this move is successful and even if it would cause fainting, the user loses 1/2 of its maximum HP, rounded up, unless the user has the Magic Guard Ability. This move is prevented from executing and the user does not lose HP if any active Pokemon has the Damp Ability, or if this move is Fire type and the user is affected by Powder or the weather is Primordial Sea.

mirrorshot.name: Mirror Shot
mirrorshot.shortDesc: 30% chance to lower the target's accuracy by 1.
mirrorshot.desc: Has a 30% chance to lower the target's accuracy by 1 stage.

naturesmadness.name: Nature's Madness
naturesmadness.shortDesc: Does damage equal to 1/2 target's current HP.
naturesmadness.desc: Deals damage to the target equal to half of its current HP, rounded down, but not less than 1 HP.

oblivionwing.name: Oblivion Wing
oblivionwing.shortDesc: User recovers 75% of the damage dealt.
oblivionwing.desc: The user recovers 3/4 the HP lost by the target, rounded half up. If Big Root is held by the user, the HP recovered is 1.3x normal, rounded half down.

octazooka.name: Octazooka
octazooka.shortDesc: 50% chance to lower the target's accuracy by 1.
octazooka.desc: Has a 50% chance to lower the target's accuracy by 1 stage.

razorwind.name: Razor Wind
razorwind.desc: Charges up on first turn, attacks on the second turn

searingshot.name: Searing Shot
searingshot.desc: Has a 30% chance to burn the target.

shelltrap.name: Shell Trap
shelltrap.shortDesc: User must take physical damage before moving.
shelltrap.desc: Fails unless the user is hit by a physical attack from an opponent this turn before it can execute the move. If the user was hit and has not fainted, it attacks immediately after being hit, and the effect ends. If the opponent's physical attack had a secondary effect removed by the Sheer Force Ability, it does not count for the purposes of this effect.

sonicboom.name: Sonic Boom
sonicboom.desc: Deals 20 HP of damage to the target.

trumpcard.name: Trump Card
trumpcard.shortDesc: More power the fewer PP this move has left.
trumpcard.desc: The power of this move is based on the amount of PP remaining after normal PP reduction and the Pressure Ability resolve. 200 power for 0 PP, 80 power for 1 PP, 60 power for 2 PP, 50 power for 3 PP, and 40 power for 4 or more PP.

wringout.name: Wring Out
wringout.shortDesc: More power the more HP the target has left.
wringout.desc: Power is equal to 120 * (target's current HP / target's maximum HP), rounded half down, but not less than 1.

assist.name: Assist
assist.shortDesc: Uses a random move known by a team member.
assist.desc: A random move among those known by the user's party members is selected for use. Does not select Assist, Baneful Bunker, Beak Blast, Belch, Bestow, Blazing Torque, Bounce, Celebrate, Chatter, Circle Throw, Combat Torque, Copycat, Counter, Covet, Destiny Bond, Detect, Dig, Dive, Dragon Tail, Endure, Feint, Fly, Focus Punch, Follow Me, Helping Hand, Hold Hands, King's Shield, Magical Torque, Mat Block, Me First, Metronome, Mimic, Mirror Coat, Mirror Move, Nature Power, Noxious Torque, Phantom Force, Protect, Rage Powder, Roar, Shadow Force, Shell Trap, Sketch, Sky Drop, Sleep Talk, Snatch, Spiky Shield, Spotlight, Struggle, Switcheroo, Tera Starstorm, Thief, Transform, Trick, Whirlwind, or Wicked Torque.

barrier.name: Barrier
barrier.desc: Raises the user's Defense by 2 stages.

bestow.name: Bestow
bestow.shortDesc: User passes its held item to the target.
bestow.desc: The target receives the user's held item. Fails if the user has no item or is holding a Mail or Z-Crystal, if the target is already holding an item, if the user is a Kyogre holding a Blue Orb, a Groudon holding a Red Orb, a Giratina holding a Griseous Orb, an Arceus holding a Plate, a Genesect holding a Drive, a Silvally holding a Memory, a Pokemon that can Mega Evolve holding the Mega Stone for its species, or if the target is one of those Pokemon and the user is holding the respective item.

camouflage.name: Camouflage
camouflage.shortDesc: Changes user's type by terrain (default Normal).
camouflage.desc: The user's type changes based on the battle terrain. Normal type on the regular Wi-Fi terrain, Electric type during Electric Terrain, Fairy type during Misty Terrain, Grass type during Grassy Terrain, and Psychic type during Psychic Terrain. Fails if the user's type cannot be changed or if the user is already purely that type.

captivate.name: Captivate
captivate.shortDesc: Lowers the foe(s) Sp. Atk by 2 if opposite gender.
captivate.desc: Lowers the target's Special Attack by 2 stages. The target is unaffected if both the user and the target are the same gender, or if either is genderless. Pokemon with the Oblivious Ability are immune.

craftyshield.name: Crafty Shield
craftyshield.shortDesc: +3 priority. Protects user and ally from Status moves
craftyshield.desc: +3 priority. Protects user and ally from Status moves

foresight.name: Foresight
foresight.shortDesc: Fighting, Normal hit Ghost. Evasiveness ignored.
foresight.desc: As long as the target remains active, its evasiveness stat stage is ignored during accuracy checks against it if it is greater than 0, and Normal- and Fighting-type attacks can hit the target if it is a Ghost type. Fails if the target is already affected, or affected by Miracle Eye or Odor Sleuth.

gearup.name: Gear Up
gearup.shortDesc: Raises Atk, Sp. Atk of allies with Plus/Minus by 1.
gearup.desc: Raises the Attack and Special Attack of Pokemon on the user's side with the Plus or Minus Abilities by 1 stage.

geomancy.name: Geomancy
geomancy.desc: Charges up on first turn, Boosts user's Attack, Special Attack, Speed +2 stages on the second turn

iondeluge.name: Ion Deluge
iondeluge.shortDesc: +1 priority. Till end of turn: Normal moves -> Electric moves
iondeluge.desc: +1 priority. All Normal type moves on the field become Electric type for the rest of the turn

laserfocus.name: Laser Focus
laserfocus.shortDesc: Until the end of the next turn, user's moves crit.
laserfocus.desc: Until the end of the next turn, the user's attacks will be critical hits.

luckychant.name: Lucky Chant
luckychant.shortDesc: For 5 turns, shields user's party from critical hits.
luckychant.desc: For 5 turns, the user and its party members cannot be struck by a critical hit. Fails if the effect is already active on the user's side.

mindreader.name: Mind Reader
mindreader.shortDesc: User's next move will not miss the target.
mindreader.desc: Until the end of the next turn, the target cannot avoid the user's moves, even if the target is in the middle of a two-turn move. The effect ends if either the user or the target leaves the field. Fails if this effect is active for the user.

miracleeye.name: Miracle Eye
miracleeye.desc: As long as the target remains active, its evasiveness stat stage is ignored during accuracy checks against it if it is greater than 0, and Psychic-type attacks can hit the target if it is a Dark type. Fails if the target is already affected, or affected by Foresight or Odor Sleuth.

mirrormove.name: Mirror Move
mirrormove.shortDesc: User uses the target's last used move against it.
mirrormove.desc: The user uses the last move used by the target. The copied move is used against that target, if possible. Fails if the target has not made a move, or if the last move used cannot be copied by this move.

mudsport.name: Mud Sport
mudsport.shortDesc: For 5 turns, Electric-type attacks have 1/3 power.
mudsport.desc: For 5 turns, all Electric-type attacks used by any active Pokemon have their power multiplied by 0.33. Fails if this effect is already active.

obstruct.name: Obstruct
obstruct.shortDesc: Protects from damaging attacks. Contact: -2 Def.
obstruct.desc: The user is protected from most attacks made by other Pokemon during this turn, and Pokemon trying to make contact with the user have their Defense lowered by 2 stages. Non-damaging moves go through this protection. This move has a 1/X chance of being successful, where X starts at 1 and triples each time this move is successfully used. X resets to 1 if this move fails, if the user's last move used is not Baneful Bunker, Burning Bulwark, Detect, Endure, King's Shield, Max Guard, Obstruct, Protect, Quick Guard, Silk Trap, Spiky Shield, or Wide Guard, or if it was one of those moves and the user's protection was broken. Fails if the user moves last this turn.

odorsleuth.name: Odor Sleuth
odorsleuth.shortDesc: Fighting, Normal hit Ghost. Evasiveness ignored.
odorsleuth.desc: As long as the target remains active, its evasiveness stat stage is ignored during accuracy checks against it if it is greater than 0, and Normal- and Fighting-type attacks can hit the target if it is a Ghost type. Fails if the target is already affected, or affected by Foresight or Miracle Eye.

rototiller.name: Rototiller
rototiller.shortDesc: Raises Atk/Sp. Atk of grounded Grass types by 1.
rototiller.desc: Raises the Attack and Special Attack of all grounded Grass-type Pokemon on the field by 1 stage.

spiderweb.name: Spider Web
spiderweb.shortDesc: Prevents the target from switching out.
spiderweb.desc: Prevents the target from switching out. The target can still switch out if it is holding Shed Shell or uses Baton Pass, Flip Turn, Parting Shot, Teleport, U-turn, or Volt Switch. The effect ends if either the user or the target leaves the field.

spotlight.name: Spotlight
spotlight.shortDesc: +3 priority. Forces the field to target target for the rest of the turn
spotlight.desc: +3 priority. Forces the field to target target for the rest of the turn

trickortreat.name: Trick-or-Treat
trickortreat.shortDesc: Adds Ghost to the target's type(s).
trickortreat.desc: Causes the Ghost type to be added to the target, effectively making it have two or three types. Fails if the target is already a Ghost type. If Forest's Curse adds a type to the target, it replaces the type added by this move and vice versa.

venomdrench.name: Venom Drench
venomdrench.shortDesc: Lowers Atk/Sp. Atk/Speed of poisoned foes by 1.
venomdrench.desc: Lowers the target's Attack, Special Attack, and Speed by 1 stage if the target is poisoned. Fails if the target is not poisoned.

watersport.name: Water Sport
watersport.shortDesc: For 5 turns, Fire-type attacks have 1/3 power.
watersport.desc: For 5 turns, all Fire-type attacks used by any active Pokemon have their power multiplied by 0.33. Fails if this effect is already active.
